mapper.sql: product_id, product_code, product_name, category, brand, unit, unit_price, stock_quantity, min_stock, status, production_date, description, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product ORDER BY product_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_code, product_name, category, brand, unit, unit_price, stock_quantity, min_stock, status, production_date, description) VALUES (#{productCode}, #{productName}, #{category}, #{brand}, #{unit}, #{unitPrice}, #{stockQuantity}, #{minStock}, #{status}, #{productionDate}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET product_code = #{productCode}, product_name = #{productName}, category = #{category}, brand = #{brand}, unit = #{unit}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, min_stock = #{minStock}, status = #{status}, production_date = #{productionDate}, description = #{description} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
